_meta.how_checked: Dates were checked on 7 November 2026 against several secondary compliance calendars. They were not yet checked line by line against each official notification, and the extensions the government announces during the year are NOT included.
_meta.scope_note: Due dates here are the standard statutory dates. A date that falls on a Sunday or a holiday is not shifted automatically; whether the next working day applies depends on the specific law.
not_included: Income-tax return (ITR) due dates, because the rules for tax year 2026-27 changed with the Income-tax Act, 2025 and sources disagree
State-specific taxes such as professional tax
Any extension notified after the as_of date
Form and challan names are those used up to 31 March 2026; the Income-tax Rules, 2026 may have renumbered some of them
_meta.qrmp_note: QRMP GSTR-3B is due on the 22nd for states in the first group and the 24th for the rest; the group comes from the state of registration.
_meta.confidence_note: Every entry is marked medium: none has yet been checked line by line against its official notification.

deadlines.name: GSTR-1 (monthly filers)
deadlines.applies_to: Registered persons filing monthly (and not in the QRMP scheme)
deadlines.period: Outward supplies of the previous month

deadlines.name: GSTR-1 (QRMP quarterly filers)
deadlines.applies_to: Registered persons in the QRMP scheme (turnover up to Rs 5 crore)
deadlines.period: Outward supplies of the quarter that just ended

deadlines.name: Invoice Furnishing Facility (QRMP)
deadlines.applies_to: QRMP filers who choose to upload B2B invoices for months 1 and 2 of a quarter
deadlines.period: Invoices of the previous month (optional)

deadlines.name: GSTR-3B (monthly filers)
deadlines.applies_to: Registered persons filing monthly (and not in the QRMP scheme)
deadlines.period: Summary return and tax payment for the previous month

deadlines.name: GSTR-3B (QRMP quarterly filers)
deadlines.applies_to: Registered persons in the QRMP scheme. Due on the 22nd or the 24th depending on the state of registration.
deadlines.period: Summary return and tax payment for the quarter that just ended
deadlines.legal_basis: CGST Rules, 2017, rule 61, and the CBIC notifications that group states into 22nd and 24th

deadlines.name: PMT-06 monthly tax payment (QRMP)
deadlines.applies_to: QRMP filers paying tax for months 1 and 2 of a quarter
deadlines.period: Tax payment for the previous month

deadlines.name: CMP-08 (composition scheme)
deadlines.applies_to: Composition taxpayers
deadlines.period: Self-assessed tax for the quarter that just ended

deadlines.name: GSTR-4 annual return (composition scheme)
deadlines.applies_to: Composition taxpayers
deadlines.period: The financial year that just ended

deadlines.name: GSTR-6 (Input Service Distributors)
deadlines.applies_to: Input Service Distributors
deadlines.period: The previous month

deadlines.name: GSTR-7 (TDS) and GSTR-8 (TCS) under GST
deadlines.applies_to: Persons deducting TDS under GST, and e-commerce operators collecting TCS
deadlines.period: The previous month

deadlines.name: GSTR-9 annual return (and GSTR-9C where applicable)
deadlines.applies_to: Regular taxpayers above the exemption threshold
deadlines.period: The financial year that ended on the previous 31 March (the 31 December 2026 return is for 2025-26)
deadlines.legal_basis: CGST Rules, 2017, rule 80. This date is often extended by notification.
deadlines.notes: Check the current notification; extensions are common.

deadlines.name: TDS and TCS deposit
deadlines.applies_to: Deductors and collectors of tax
deadlines.period: Tax deducted or collected in the previous month. For March the due date is 30 April.
deadlines.legal_basis: Income-tax Rules (deposit of tax deducted at source); Income-tax Act, 2025 for tax years from 1 April 2026
deadlines.notes: Government deductors paying without a challan follow a different date.

deadlines.name: TDS return (Forms 24Q, 26Q, 27Q)
deadlines.applies_to: Deductors, quarterly statement. Due 31 July, 31 October and 31 January for the first three quarters and 31 May for the last.
deadlines.period: The quarter that just ended (Q4 return is due 31 May)
deadlines.legal_basis: Income-tax Rules (statement of deduction of tax)

deadlines.name: Form 16 (salary TDS certificate)
deadlines.applies_to: Employers, to employees
deadlines.period: The financial year that just ended

deadlines.name: Advance tax instalment
deadlines.applies_to: Taxpayers whose tax payable is Rs 10,000 or more. 15 June: 15%, 15 September: 45%, 15 December: 75%, 15 March: 100% of the year's advance tax.
deadlines.period: The current financial year
deadlines.legal_basis: Income-tax Act, 1961 section 211 (until 31 March 2026); Income-tax Act, 2025 for tax years from 1 April 2026
deadlines.notes: Taxpayers on the presumptive scheme (sections 44AD and 44ADA) pay the whole advance tax in one instalment by 15 March.

deadlines.name: Provident Fund (EPF) contribution
deadlines.applies_to: Establishments covered by the EPF Act
deadlines.period: Contributions for the previous month
deadlines.notes: A grace period of 5 days exists for interest and damages in some cases, but the due date is the 15th.

deadlines.name: ESI contribution
deadlines.applies_to: Establishments covered by the ESI Act
deadlines.period: Contributions for the previous month

deadlines.name: DIR-3 KYC (director KYC)
deadlines.applies_to: Directors holding a DIN allotted on or before 31 March of the year
deadlines.period: The financial year that just ended
deadlines.legal_basis: Companies (Appointment and Qualification of Directors) Rules, 2014, rule 12A

deadlines.name: DPT-3 return of deposits
deadlines.applies_to: Companies that accepted deposits or have outstanding loans reported under this form
deadlines.period: The financial year that ended on 31 March
deadlines.legal_basis: Companies (Acceptance of Deposits) Rules, 2014, rules 16 and 16A

deadlines.name: MSME-1 half-yearly return
deadlines.applies_to: Companies with outstanding payments to micro or small enterprises over 45 days
deadlines.period: October to March (due 30 April); April to September (due 31 October)
deadlines.legal_basis: MCA notification on specified companies (Companies Act, 2013 section 405)

event_based.name: Annual General Meeting (AGM)
event_based.rule: Within 6 months of the end of the financial year, so by 30 September for a 31 March year end

event_based.name: ADT-1 (auditor appointment)
event_based.rule: Within 15 days of the AGM at which the auditor is appointed
event_based.legal_basis: Companies Act, 2013, section 139 and the Audit and Auditors Rules, 2014
